newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD ruling may come Monday - judge.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD ruling may come Monday - judge.

text.p: A Brazilian high court justice said he could decide on Monday whether the government's planned sell-off of state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce can move forward.
"I will examine the process on Saturday and Sunday and on Monday I may have a decision," Justice Democrito Ramos Reinaldo, of Brazil's Superior Court of Justice (STJ), told reporters on Thursday.
The auction of CVRD, originally planned for last Tuesday, has been delayed by a number of legal challenges in courts throughout Brazil.
The government is asking the STJ to rule that all lawsuits against the sale should be handled by a single court to avoid "conflicts of interpretation."
But the STJ justice wants the government to provide more information before he makes a decision and he has given officials 10 days to do so.
Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said Brasilia would provide the information early on Friday.

With the sale of a maximum 45 percent voting stake in CVRD, the government hopes to net at least $2.8 billion. But bidders are expected to pay a premium for the firm and analysts say the sale may bring in some $5.0 billion to government coffers.
The auction is expected to be Latin America's biggest privatization to date.
